name: Aaron's Support — Discord Modmail (Node.js 24)
author: maintainers@aaronssupport.invalid
description: Self-contained Discord modmail with Components V2, SQLite archives, plugins, and optional OAuth logs. Installs the bundled application and locked npm dependencies automatically. Requires a Discord token, server ID and staff role IDs. Persistent config.json, data/ and plugins/ survive reinstall. No GitHub token or public source release required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 022

# Wings mounts the persistent server volume here during installation.
server_dir=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$server_dir"
cd "$server_dir"

# Abort rather than replace a folder owned by another application.
if [ -L app ] || { [ -e app ] && { [ ! -d app ] || [ ! -f app/.aarons-support-managed ]; }; }; then
  echo "Installation stopped: app/ already exists without the Aarons Support ownership marker." >&2
  exit 1
fi
for persistent in data plugins; do
  if [ -L "$persistent" ] || { [ -e "$persistent" ] && [ ! -d "$persistent" ]; }; then
    echo "Installation stopped: $persistent must be a regular directory." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

staging=$(mktemp -d "$server_dir/.aarons-install.XXXXXX")
previous=''
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$previous" ] && [ -d "$previous/app" ] && [ ! -e "$server_dir/app" ]; then
    mv "$previous/app" "$server_dir/app"
  fi
  rm -rf "$staging"
  if [ -n "$previous" ]; then rm -rf "$previous"; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Required. Bot token from Discord Developer Portal. This is a secret; restrict access to Startup variables. Never put it in the startup command.

variables.name: Discord Server ID
variables.description: Required. The one Discord server this bot serves. Copy its ID with Developer Mode enabled.

variables.name: Staff Role IDs
variables.description: Required. Comma-separated moderator role IDs. Do not use the everyone role. These roles receive level 2 access.

variables.name: Admin Role IDs (optional)
variables.description: Comma-separated level 4 role IDs. Blank uses saved configuration; use none to explicitly clear this list.

variables.name: Bot Owner User IDs (optional)
variables.description: Comma-separated level 5 user IDs. The Discord server owner always has level 5. Blank uses saved configuration; none clears the extra list.

variables.name: Inbox Category ID (optional)
variables.description: Existing private category ID. Leave blank and run .setup as server owner to create one. A filled panel value overrides saved configuration on restart.

variables.name: Log Channel ID (optional)
variables.description: Existing private log text-channel ID. Leave blank for .setup. A filled panel value overrides saved configuration on restart.

variables.name: Prefix Override (optional)
variables.description: Default prefix is a dot. Leave blank to keep config.json or the persisted .prefix command setting. Fill this to enforce a prefix on each restart.

variables.name: Private Log Viewer URL (optional)
variables.description: Public HTTPS origin, for example https://logs.example.com. Leave blank to disable the viewer. Requires OAuth variables and a reverse proxy to this server's primary allocation.

variables.name: OAuth Application ID (optional)
variables.description: Discord OAuth client/application ID. Required only when the private log viewer is enabled.

variables.name: OAuth Client Secret (optional)
variables.description: Secret from the Discord OAuth page. Required only for the log viewer. Restrict access to Startup variables.
